name: The Tolling Giant
look: An eight-metre giant with ash-grey skin and a blindfold of chained iron, wearing a cathedral's broken roof timbers as armour, swinging a great bronze bell on a heavy chain from the RIGHT hand as a flail, bare feet, a long matted beard.

idle.note: Standing at rest, slow breathing and a small weight shift; F6 flows back into F1.

walk.note: Walking loop in place (the game moves the sprite); F6 flows into F1.

run.note: Running loop in place, leaning into the run; F6 flows into F1.

jump.note: Jump. Keep the body near the ground line: the game lifts the sprite, the frames only change the pose.

flail.note: Swings the bell flail round in a wide arc. Slow heavy attack with a long, readable wind-up; damage lands on F5.

bell_slam.note: Lifts the bell overhead and slams it down; it tolls on impact. Slow heavy attack with a long, readable wind-up; damage lands on F5.

stomp.note: Raises a foot and stamps; the game spawns a shockwave on F4. Leaping attack: the game moves the creature forward and up; damage lands on F4 as it comes down.

toll.note: Rings the bell to stun (the game spawns a sound wave on F3). Roar / taunt: head up, jaws wide on F3-F4.

hurt.note: Pain flinch: knocked back on F1-F2, recovers to the idle pose by F6.

death.note: Death: collapses onto the ground line. F6 is held, then swapped for the corpse, so F6 must match the corpse sheet in the same direction.
